name: Cubist machine
description: Modernist cubism of the machine age: bold black outlines, flat primary colours, tubes, cylinders, discs and stylised figures locked into a geometric grid.
light: no light source, flat colour, at most simple tubular shading
flat colour with a black night ground and yellow lights
pale pastel version of the primaries on cream
stained-glass light, colours glowing between black leading
composition: tight geometric grid, overlapping planes, a figure or still life broken into cylinders and discs
one large figure or face filling the frame, built from cones and plates
a city or factory panorama of stacked geometric blocks
a still life on a table, seen from several angles at once
camera_or_medium: oil or gouache poster in flat colour; mosaic and stained-glass variants
texture_detail: thick black contours, flat red, yellow and blue, cream paper, slight print texture
subjects: a cyclist built of tubes and discs
a still life of jugs and gears
a worker on a scaffold in a geometric city
